claims.claim: Router organizes deployments into buckets containing unified or separate prefill/decode engine groups.
claims.notes: Bucket order uses SLO preference, capacity and rank.

claims.claim: The reorg request path performs preprocessing, bucket selection, admission, policy selection, dispatch and retry.
claims.notes: Retry is bounded and applies to dispatch failures before response.

claims.claim: Cache-aware routing prefers the longest cached prefix owner that satisfies the minimum match threshold and admission.
claims.notes: Only plain and prefill groups; decode behavior differs.

claims.claim: Session bindings live in each router replica and require sticky routing when multiple replicas are used.
claims.notes: Router replicas rebuild routing state from worker reports and KV events.

claims.claim: Router metrics expose TTFT, active load, worker health, KV event batches and cache prefix signals.
claims.notes: Metric names and labels are version-specific.

claims.claim: Balanced routing switches from prefix owner A to alternative B only when both factor and absolute-gap conditions hold.
claims.notes: Restatement of documented policy, not a measured score.
